intro.en: A reading text about globalization (al-ʿawlama): some people welcome it, some dislike it, and some fear for religion and identity. Read slowly, sentence by sentence, and learn the new words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum «العَوْلَمَة» (aalamgeeriyat) ke baare mein ek mazmoon parhenge: kuch log ise pasand karte hain, kuch napasand, aur kuch deen aur shanakht ke liye fikr mand hain. Aahista aahista parhein aur naye alfaz seekhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنِ العَوْلَمَةِ: بَعْضُ النّاسِ يَرْحَبُ بِها، وَبَعْضُهُمْ يَكْرَهُها، وَبَعْضُهُمْ يَخافُ عَلَى الدّينِ وَالهُوِيَّةِ. اِقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً وَتَعَلَّمِ الكَلِماتِ الجَديدَةَ.

dialogue.ar: تَرْبِطُ العَوْلَمَةُ بَيْنَ بُلْدانِ العالَمِ بِالتِّجارَةِ وَالاتِّصالاتِ حَتّى صارَ العالَمُ كَقَرْيَةٍ صَغيرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: tarbiṭul-ʿawlamatu bayna buldānil-ʿālami bit-tijārati wal-ittiṣālāt, ḥattā ṣāral-ʿālamu ka-qaryatin ṣaghīrah
dialogue.en: Globalization links the countries of the world through trade and communications until the world became like a small village.
dialogue.ur: Aalamgeeriyat duniya ke mulkon ko tijarat aur rabton se jorti hai, yahan tak ke duniya ek chhote gaon jaisi ho gayi.

dialogue.ar: فَيَرى بَعْضُ النّاسِ فِيها فُرْصَةً لِلتَّنافُسِ وَالنَّهْضَةِ وَانْتِقالِ الدَّواءِ وَالعِلْمِ بَيْنَ الأُمَمِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-yarā baʿḍun-nāsi fīhā furṣatan lit-tanāfusi wan-nahḍati wa intiqālid-dawāʾi wal-ʿilmi baynal-umam
dialogue.en: Some people see in it a chance for competition, revival and the movement of medicine and knowledge between nations.
dialogue.ur: Kuch log ise muqable, nehzat aur qaumon ke darmiyan dawa aur ilm ke muntaqil hone ka mauqa samajhte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيُعْجَبُ آخَرونَ بِنَمَطِ الحَياةِ الغَرْبِيِّ فَيُقَلِّدونَهُ في اللِّباسِ وَالطَّعامِ، فَهُمْ مَفْتونونَ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yuʿjabu ākharūna bi-namaṭil-ḥayātil-gharbiyyi fa-yuqallidūnahu fil-libāsi waṭ-ṭaʿām, fa-hum maftūnūna bih
dialogue.en: Others admire the Western way of life and imitate it in clothes and food; they are captivated by it.
dialogue.ur: Doosre maghribi tarz-e-zindagi se mutasir hote hain aur libas aur khane mein uski naqal karte hain; woh us par fida hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَكْرَهُها فَريقٌ ثالِثٌ لِأَنَّ الأَقْوِياءَ يَسْتَغِلّونَ بِها الضُّعَفاءَ لِتَحْقيقِ الرِّبْحِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yakrahuhā farīqun thālithun li-anna l-aqwiyāʾa yastaghillūna bihā ḍ-ḍuʿafāʾa li-taḥqīqir-ribḥ
dialogue.en: A third group dislikes it because the strong use it to exploit the weak in order to make profit.
dialogue.ur: Teesra giroh ise napasand karta hai kyunke taqatwar log ise kamzoron ke istehsal aur munafa kamane ke liye istemal karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَخافُ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلى هُوِيَّتِهِمُ الثَّقافِيَّةِ وَلُغَتِهِمْ مِنَ الذَّوَبانِ في ثَقافَةٍ أُخْرى.
dialogue.tr: wa yakhāfu baʿḍuhum ʿalā huwiyyatihimuth-thaqāfiyyati wa lughatihim minadh-dhawabāni fī thaqāfatin ukhrā
dialogue.en: Some fear for their cultural identity and language, that they might dissolve into another culture.
dialogue.ur: Kuch log apni saqafati shanakht aur zubaan ke liye dartay hain ke kahin woh kisi aur saqafat mein ghul na jayen.

dialogue.ar: وَيَقولُ الكارِهونَ: هَذا غَزْوٌ ثَقافِيٌّ يُهَدِّدُ دينَنا وَعاداتِنا.
dialogue.tr: wa yaqūlul-kārihūn: hādhā ghazwun thaqāfiyyun yuhaddidu dīnanā wa ʿādātinā
dialogue.en: Those who dislike it say: this is a cultural invasion that threatens our religion and customs.
dialogue.ur: Napasand karne wale kehte hain: yeh saqafati yalghar hai jo hamare deen aur riwajon ke liye khatra hai.

dialogue.ar: وَطَرَفٌ آخَرُ يَسْخَرُ مِمَّنْ يُحافِظُ عَلى تُراثِهِ، وَهذِهِ سُخْرِيَةٌ لا تُفيدُ أَحَداً.
dialogue.tr: wa ṭarafun ākharu yaskharu mimman yuḥāfiẓu ʿalā turāthih, wa hādhihi sukhriyyatun lā tufīdu aḥadā
dialogue.en: Another side mocks whoever preserves his heritage, and this mockery benefits no one.
dialogue.ur: Ek aur taraf apni wirasat bachane walon ka mazaq udata hai, aur yeh mazaq kisi ke kaam ka nahi.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا المَوْقِفُ المُتَوازِنُ فَيَأْخُذُ النّافِعَ كَالدَّواءِ وَالتِّقْنِيَةِ وَيَتْرُكُ الضّارَّ.
dialogue.tr: ammal-mawqifulul-mutawāzinu fa-yaʾkhudhun-nāfiʿa kad-dawāʾi wat-tiqniyyati wa yatrukuḍ-ḍārr
dialogue.en: The balanced position takes what is useful, like medicine and technology, and leaves what is harmful.
dialogue.ur: Mutawazin mauqif faide ki cheezein jaise dawa aur technology leta hai aur nuqsan-deh cheezein chhor deta hai.

dialogue.ar: فَالأُمَّةُ القَوِيَّةُ تُحافِظُ عَلى دينِها وَلُغَتِها وَتَنْفَتِحُ عَلى العالَمِ بِوَعْيٍ.
dialogue.tr: fal-ummatul-qawiyyatu tuḥāfiẓu ʿalā dīnihā wa lughatihā wa tanfatiḥu ʿalal-ʿālami bi-waʿy
dialogue.en: A strong nation protects its religion and language and opens up to the world with awareness.
dialogue.ur: Mazboot qaum apne deen aur zubaan ki hifazat karti hai aur shaoor ke saath duniya ke liye khulti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالمُسْتَضْعَفُ يَحْتاجُ إِلى العِلْمِ وَالاسْتِقْلالِ الاقْتِصادِيِّ لِيَحْمِيَ نَفْسَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wal-mustaḍʿafu yaḥtāju ilal-ʿilmi wal-istiqlālil-iqtiṣādiyyi li-yaḥmiya nafsah
dialogue.en: The weak need knowledge and economic independence to protect themselves.
dialogue.ur: Kamzor ko apni hifazat ke liye ilm aur maashi khud-mukhtari ki zarurat hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهكَذا لَيْسَتِ العَوْلَمَةُ خَيْراً كُلَّها وَلا شَرّاً كُلَّها، وَأَثَرُها يَتَوَقَّفُ عَلى حِكْمَةِ الشُّعوبِ.
dialogue.tr: wa hākadhā laysatil-ʿawlamatu khayran kullahā wa lā sharran kullahā, wa atharuhā yatawaqqafu ʿalā ḥikmatish-shuʿūb
dialogue.en: So globalization is neither all good nor all bad; its effect depends on the wisdom of peoples.
dialogue.ur: Yun aalamgeeriyat na poori achhi hai na poori buri; uska asar qaumon ki danishmandi par mabni hai.

options_ar: انْتِشارُ الأَفْكارِ وَالاقْتِصادِ بَيْنَ بُلْدانِ العالَمِ حَتّى يَتَقارَبَ
ما يُمَيِّزُ الشَّخْصَ أَوِ الأُمَّةَ مِنْ دينٍ وَلُغَةٍ وَثَقافَةٍ

q.en: Why do some people dislike globalization, according to the text?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq kuch log aalamgeeriyat ko napasand kyun karte hain?
q.ar: لِماذا يَكْرَهُ بَعْضُ النّاسِ العَوْلَمَةَ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

options: The strong exploit the weak for profit, and they fear for their identity
options_ar: لِأَنَّ الأَقْوِياءَ يَسْتَغِلّونَ الضُّعَفاءَ لِلرِّبْحِ وَيَخافونَ عَلى هُوِيَّتِهِمْ

q.en: What does the balanced position do with globalization?
q.ur: Mutawazin mauqif aalamgeeriyat ke saath kya karta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَفْعَلُ المَوْقِفُ المُتَوازِنُ تُجاهَ العَوْلَمَةِ؟

options: Takes what is useful and leaves what is harmful

title.en: Grammar A: The verbal noun-word (ism al-fiʿl)

intro.en: An «اسْمُ الفِعْلِ» is a word that looks like a noun but works like a verb. For example «عَلَيْكَ» means «الْزَمْ» (hold on to) and «إِلَيْكَ» means «ابْتَعِدْ» (keep away). Learn the examples below.
intro.ur: «اسْمُ الفِعْلِ» aisa lafz hai jo dekhne mein ism hota hai lekin kaam fial ka karta hai. Misal: «عَلَيْكَ» ka matlab «الْزَمْ» (pakad lo) aur «إِلَيْكَ» ka matlab «ابْتَعِدْ» (door raho). Neeche ki misalein seekhein.
intro.ar: «اسْمُ الفِعْلِ» كَلِمَةٌ شَكْلُها اسْمٌ وَعَمَلُها عَمَلُ الفِعْلِ. فَمَثَلًا «عَلَيْكَ» بِمَعْنى «الْزَمْ» وَ«إِلَيْكَ» بِمَعْنى «اِبْتَعِدْ». تَعَلَّمِ الأَمْثِلَةَ الآتِيَةَ.

dialogue.ar: دونَكَ القَلَمَ فَاكْتُبْ بِهِ الدَّرْسَ.
dialogue.tr: dūnakal-qalama fa-ktub bihid-dars
dialogue.en: Here is the pen, so write the lesson with it.
dialogue.ur: Yeh lo qalam, is se sabaq likho.

dialogue.ar: عَلَيْكَ بِالرِّفْقِ مَعَ النّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿalayka bir-rifqi maʿan-nās
dialogue.en: Hold on to gentleness with people.
dialogue.ur: Logon ke saath narmi ko lazim pakdo.

dialogue.ar: مَكانَكَ، لا تَتَحَرَّكْ حَتّى يَنْتَهِيَ المَطَرُ.
dialogue.tr: makānak, lā tataḥarrak ḥattā yantahiyal-maṭar
dialogue.en: Stay where you are, do not move until the rain ends.
dialogue.ur: Apni jagah raho, baarish khatam hone tak hilo mat.

dialogue.ar: إِلَيْكَ عَنِّي، فَأَنا مَشْغولٌ بِدَرْسي.
dialogue.tr: ilayka ʿannī, fa-ana mashghūlun bi-darsī
dialogue.en: Keep away from me, I am busy with my lesson.
dialogue.ur: Mujh se door raho, main apne sabaq mein masroof hoon.

dialogue.ar: أَمامَكَ، وَلا تَخَفْ مِنَ الصُّعوباتِ.
dialogue.tr: amāmak, wa lā takhaf minaṣ-ṣuʿūbāt
dialogue.en: Go forward, and do not fear the difficulties.
dialogue.ur: Aage barho, aur mushkilon se mat daro.

dialogue.ar: هاكَ الدَّفْتَرَ يا سَعيدُ.
dialogue.tr: hāka d-daftara yā saʿīd
dialogue.en: Here, take the notebook, Saeed.
dialogue.ur: Yeh lo copy, Saeed.

dialogue.ar: عَلَيْكُمْ بِالصِّدْقِ، فَإِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدي إِلى البِرِّ
dialogue.tr: ʿalaykum biṣ-ṣidq, fa-inna ṣ-ṣidqa yahdī ilal-birr
dialogue.en: Hold fast to truthfulness, for truthfulness guides to goodness.
dialogue.ur: Sach ko lazim pakdo, kyunke sach neki ki taraf le jata hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلُمَّ إِلى المَكْتَبَةِ نَقْرَأْ مَعاً.
dialogue.tr: halumma ilal-maktabati naqraʾ maʿā
dialogue.en: Come to the library, let us read together.
dialogue.ur: Library chalo, hum mil kar parhein.

dialogue.ar: آمينَ.
dialogue.tr: āmīn
dialogue.en: Ameen (O Allah, answer).
dialogue.ur: Ameen (ya Allah qubool farma).

vocab.ur: ism-ul-fial (ism jo fial ka kaam kare)

options: A noun-word that acts like a verb
A verb that acts like a noun
options_ar: كَلِمَةٌ شَكْلُها اسْمٌ وَعَمَلُها عَمَلُ الفِعْلِ

title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Hazrat Umar ke qisse

intro.en: Listen to stories about the caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him) and answer true-or-false and multiple-choice questions. These pages are exercises, so listen and check your answers.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Hazrat Umar bin al-Khattab (Allah un se razi ho) ke qisse sun kar sahi/ghalat aur multiple choice sawalat hal karne hain. Pehle sunein, phir jawab jaanchein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى قِصَصٍ عَنِ الخَليفَةِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الخَطّابِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ وَالاخْتِيارِ. هَذِهِ الصَّفَحاتُ تَمارينُ، فَاسْتَمِعْ وَتَحَقَّقْ مِنْ إِجاباتِكَ.

dialogue.ar: كانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطّابِ -رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ- يَتَفَقَّدُ أَحْوالَ رَعِيَّتِهِ في اللَّيْلِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna ʿumaru bnul-khaṭṭāb raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu yatafaqqadu aḥwāla raʿiyyatihi fil-layl
dialogue.en: Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, used to check on the condition of his people at night.
dialogue.ur: Umar bin Khattab (raziyallahu anhu) raat ko apni raiyyat ka haal dekhne nikalte the.

dialogue.ar: وَذاتَ لَيْلَةٍ رَأى امْرَأَةً تُوقِدُ النّارَ تَحْتَ قِدْرٍ وَأَطْفالُها يَبْكونَ مِنَ الجوعِ.
dialogue.tr: wa dhāta laylatin raʾā imraʾatan tūqidun-nāra taḥta qidrin wa aṭfāluhā yabkūna minal-jūʿ
dialogue.en: One night he saw a woman lighting a fire under a pot while her children cried from hunger.
dialogue.ur: Ek raat unhon ne ek aurat dekhi jo deg ke neeche aag jala rahi thi aur uske bachche bhook se ro rahe the.

dialogue.ar: فَذَهَبَ إِلى بَيْتِ المالِ وَحَمَلَ الدَّقيقَ عَلى ظَهْرِهِ بِنَفْسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-dhahaba ilā baytil-māli wa ḥamalad-daqīqa ʿalā ẓahrihi bi-nafsih
dialogue.en: So he went to the treasury and carried the flour on his own back himself.
dialogue.ur: Woh baitul maal gaye aur aate ko khud apni peeth par utha laye.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ طَبَخَ لَهُمُ الطَّعامَ بِيَدِهِ حَتّى شَبِعوا وَفَرِحَ الأَطْفالُ.
dialogue.tr: thumma ṭabakha lahumuṭ-ṭaʿāma bi-yadihi ḥattā shabiʿū wa fariḥal-aṭfāl
dialogue.en: Then he cooked the food for them with his own hand until they were full and the children rejoiced.
dialogue.ur: Phir unhon ne apne haath se khana pakaya yahan tak ke woh sair ho gaye aur bachche khush hue.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ يَغْضَبُ إِذا ظَلَمَ والٍ أَوْ قاضٍ أَحَداً، وَيَلْبَسُ ثَوْباً بَسيطاً.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna yaghḍabu idhā ẓalama wālin aw qāḍin aḥadan, wa yalbasu thawban basīṭā
dialogue.en: He would become angry if a governor or a judge wronged anyone, and he wore a simple garment.
dialogue.ur: Jab koi wali ya qazi kisi par zulm karta to woh ghussa hote, aur saada libas pehnte the.

dialogue.ar: وَتَحْكي الرِّواياتُ أَنَّ رَسولَ كِسْرى جاءَ يَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ فَوَجَدَهُ نائِماً تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ عَلى التُّرابِ بِلا حَرَسٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa taḥkir-riwāyātu anna rasūla kisrā jāʾa yasʾalu ʿanhu fa-wajadahu nāʾiman taḥta shajaratin ʿalat-turābi bilā ḥaras
dialogue.en: Tales say that the envoy of Kisra came asking about him and found him asleep under a tree on the earth with no guard.
dialogue.ur: Riwayaton mein hai ke Kisra ka qasid unhein poochta aaya to unhein ek darakht ke neeche mitti par bina pehredar soya hua paya.

dialogue.ar: فَتَعَجَّبَ الرَّسولُ، فَقَدْ عَرَفَ أَنَّ العَدْلَ يَجْلِبُ الأَمانَ، فَنامَ عُمَرُ مُطْمَئِنّاً.
dialogue.tr: fa-taʿajjabar-rasūl, fa-qad ʿarafa anna l-ʿadla yajlibul-amān, fa-nāma ʿumaru muṭmaʾinnan
dialogue.en: The envoy was amazed, for he understood that justice brings safety, so Umar slept at ease.
dialogue.ur: Qasid hairan hua, kyunke woh samajh gaya ke insaaf aman lata hai, isliye Umar itminan se soye.

q.en: What did Umar carry to the woman's house?
q.ur: Umar ne aurat ke ghar kya uthaya?
q.ar: ماذا حَمَلَ عُمَرُ إِلى بَيْتِ المَرْأَةِ؟

q.en: Where was Umar lying when Kisra's envoy found him?
q.ur: Kisra ka qasid mila to Umar kahan leete the?
q.ar: أَيْنَ كانَ عُمَرُ مُسْتَلْقِيًا حينَ وَجَدَهُ رَسولُ كِسْرى؟

q.en: According to the tale, why could Umar sleep safely without guards?
q.ur: Riwayat ke mutabiq Umar bina pehredar itminan se kyun so sakte the?
q.ar: لِماذا نامَ عُمَرُ آمِناً بِلا حَرَسٍ بِحَسَبِ الرِّوايَةِ؟

options_ar: ما يُغَطّي سَطْحَ الأَرْضِ وَتُزْرَعُ فيهِ النَّباتاتُ

intro.en: A short guide with tips for a good speaker: practise, speak clearly, change your tone, look dignified, be brave, speak to people at their level, and match your words with your deeds.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein achche khateeb (taqreer karne wale) ke liye hidayat hain: mashq karna, saaf bolna, lehja badalna, wiqar rakhna, himmat se bolna, logon ki samajh ke mutabiq bolna, aur qaul o amal ek rakhna.
intro.ar: إِرْشاداتٌ قَصيرَةٌ لِلخَطيبِ الجَيِّدِ: التَّدَرُّبُ، وَوُضوحُ الكَلامِ، وَتَغْييرُ نَبْرَةِ الصَّوْتِ، وَالهَيْبَةُ، وَالشَّجاعَةُ، وَمُخاطَبَةُ النّاسِ عَلى قَدْرِ عُقولِهِمْ، وَمُوافَقَةُ القَوْلِ لِلعَمَلِ.

dialogue.ar: اِبْدَأِ التَّدْريبَ مُبَكِّراً وَأَكْثِرْ مِنْ مُمارَسَةِ الخِطابَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ibdaʾit-tadrība mubakkiran wa akthir min mumārasatil-khiṭābah
dialogue.en: Start training early and practise public speaking often.
dialogue.ur: Training jaldi shuru karo aur khitabat ki mashq kasrat se karo.

dialogue.ar: تَكَلَّمْ بِصَوْتٍ واضِحٍ وَاحْرِصْ عَلى سَلامَةِ النُّطْقِ.
dialogue.tr: takallam bi-ṣawtin wāḍiḥin waḥriṣ ʿalā salāmatin-nuṭq
dialogue.en: Speak in a clear voice and take care of correct pronunciation.
dialogue.ur: Saaf awaz mein bolo aur durust talaffuz ka khayal rakho.

dialogue.ar: لَوِّنْ صَوْتَكَ بَيْنَ الرَّفْعِ وَالخَفْضِ حَتّى لا يَمَلَّ السّامِعونَ.
dialogue.tr: lawwin ṣawtaka baynar-rafʿi wal-khafḍi ḥattā lā yamallas-sāmiʿūn
dialogue.en: Vary your voice between raising and lowering it so that the listeners do not get bored.
dialogue.ur: Awaz ko oonchi neechi karte raho taake sunne walay ukta na jayein.

dialogue.ar: اِلْبَسْ لِباساً مُرَتَّباً وَقِفْ وِقْفَةً مُحْتَرَمَةً.
dialogue.tr: ilbas libāsan murattaban wa qif wiqfatan muḥtaramah
dialogue.en: Wear tidy clothes and stand in a dignified way.
dialogue.ur: Saaf suthra libas pehno aur waqar ke saath khare ho.

dialogue.ar: كُنْ جَريئاً ثابِتاً، وَلا تَدَعِ الخَوْفَ يُوقِفُ كَلامَكَ.
dialogue.tr: kun jarīʾan thābitan, wa lā tadaʿil-khawfa yūqifu kalāmak
dialogue.en: Be bold and steady, and do not let fear stop your speech.
dialogue.ur: Nidar aur sabit qadam raho, aur dar ko apni baat rokne na do.

dialogue.ar: اِخْتَرْ كَلِماتٍ يَفْهَمُها جُمْهورُكَ وَلا تَسْتَعْمِلْ كَلاماً غَريباً عَلَيْهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: ikhtar kalimātin yafhamuhā jumhūruk wa lā tastaʿmil kalāman gharīban ʿalayhim
dialogue.en: Choose words your audience understands and do not use language strange to them.
dialogue.ur: Aise alfaz chuno jo sunne wale samjhein aur unke liye ajnabi zubaan istemal na karo.

dialogue.ar: اِفْعَلْ ما تَدْعو إِلَيْهِ حَتّى يُصَدِّقَكَ النّاسُ.
dialogue.tr: ifʿal mā tadʿū ilayhi ḥattā yuṣaddiqakan-nās
dialogue.en: Do what you call people to, so that they believe you.
dialogue.ur: Jis cheez ki dawat do us par khud amal karo taake log tumhein sacha samjhein.

dialogue.ar: اِسْتَعِنْ بِالحِكْمَةِ وَابْتَعِدْ عَنِ الجَرْحِ وَالإِساءَةِ.
dialogue.tr: istaʿin bil-ḥikmati wabtaʿid ʿanil-jarḥi wal-isāʾah
dialogue.en: Use wisdom and stay away from hurting and insulting.
dialogue.ur: Hikmat se kaam lo aur dil dukhane aur bura bhala kehne se door raho.

dialogue.ar: تَدْريبٌ: تَخَيَّرْ مَوْضوعاً قَريباً مِنْ قَلْبِكَ وَقَدِّمْ فيهِ كَلِمَةً قَصيرَةً ارْتِجالاً أَمامَ زُمَلائِكَ.
dialogue.tr: tadrīb: takhayyar mawḍūʿan qarīban min qalbika wa qaddim fīhi kalimatan qaṣīratan irtijālan amāma zumalāʾik
dialogue.en: Exercise: choose a topic that matters to you and give a short talk about it in front of your classmates without notes.
dialogue.ur: Mashq: koi aisa mauzu chuno jo tumhare liye ahem ho aur apne saathiyon ke saamne bina tayyari ke chhota khitab karo.

vocab.en: off the cuff, without prepared notes

q.en: Why should a speaker change the tone of his voice?
q.ur: Khateeb ko awaaz ka lehja kyun badalna chahiye?

title.en: Grammar B: The noun of instrument (ism al-ala)

intro.en: «اسْمُ الآلَةِ» names a tool used to do an action. It has set patterns: «مِفْعَلٌ» (mifʿal), «مِفْعالٌ» (mifʿāl), «مِفْعَلَةٌ» (mifʿala) and «فَعّالَةٌ» (faʿʿāla). Example: from «فَتَحَ» (he opened) we get «مِفْتاحٌ» (key).
intro.ur: «اسْمُ الآلَةِ» us cheez ka naam hai jis se koi kaam kiya jata hai (aala/auzar). Iske wazan hain: «مِفْعَلٌ»، «مِفْعالٌ»، «مِفْعَلَةٌ»، «فَعّالَةٌ». Misal: «فَتَحَ» (usne khola) se «مِفْتاحٌ» (chabi) banta hai.
intro.ar: «اسْمُ الآلَةِ» اسْمٌ يَدُلُّ عَلى أَداةٍ يُفْعَلُ بِها الفِعْلُ. لَهُ أَوْزانٌ مَعْروفَةٌ: «مِفْعَلٌ» وَ«مِفْعالٌ» وَ«مِفْعَلَةٌ» وَ«فَعّالَةٌ». مِثالُ ذَلِكَ: مِنْ «فَتَحَ» نَقولُ «مِفْتاحٌ».

dialogue.ar: أَفْتَحُ البابَ بِالمِفْتاحِ.
dialogue.tr: aftaḥul-bāba bil-miftāḥ
dialogue.en: I open the door with the key.
dialogue.ur: Main chaabi se darwaza kholta hoon.

dialogue.ar: قَصَّتِ الخَيّاطَةُ القُماشَ بِالمِقَصِّ.
dialogue.tr: qaṣṣatil-khayyāṭatul-qumāsha bil-miqaṣṣ
dialogue.en: The seamstress cut the cloth with the scissors.
dialogue.ur: Darzan ne qainchi se kapda kata.

dialogue.ar: نَشَرَ النَّجّارُ الخَشَبَ بِالمِنْشارِ.
dialogue.tr: nasharan-najjārul-khashaba bil-minshār
dialogue.en: The carpenter sawed the wood with the saw.
dialogue.ur: Barhai ne aari se lakdi cheeri.

dialogue.ar: تُكَنِّسُ الأُمُّ الغُرْفَةَ بِالمِكْنَسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: tukannisul-ummul-ghurfata bil-miknasah
dialogue.en: The mother sweeps the room with the broom.
dialogue.ur: Maa jharoo se kamra saaf karti hai.

dialogue.ar: كَوَتْ هُدى الثَّوْبَ بِالمِكْواةِ.
dialogue.tr: kawat hudath-thawba bil-mikwāh
dialogue.en: Huda ironed the garment with the iron.
dialogue.ur: Huda ne istri se kapda istri kiya.

dialogue.ar: سَكَبَ الطّاهي الحِساءَ في الصَّحْنِ بِالمِغْرَفَةِ.
dialogue.tr: sakabaṭ-ṭāhil-ḥisāʾa fiṣ-ṣaḥni bil-mighrafah
dialogue.en: The cook poured the soup into the dish with the ladle.
dialogue.ur: Bawarchi ne chamche se shorba plate mein dala.

dialogue.ar: غَسَلَتْ فاطِمَةُ ثِيابَها بِالغَسّالَةِ وَحَفِظَتِ الطَّعامَ في الثَّلّاجَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ghasalat fāṭimatu thiyābahā bil-ghassālati wa ḥafiẓatiṭ-ṭaʿāma fith-thallājah
dialogue.en: Fatimah washed her clothes in the washing machine and kept the food in the fridge.
dialogue.ur: Fatimah ne apne kapde washing machine mein dhoye aur khana fridge mein rakha.

dialogue.ar: رَكِبَ الوَلَدُ الدَّرّاجَةَ وَنَظَرَ بِالمِنْظارِ إِلى الجَبَلِ.
dialogue.tr: rakibal-waladud-darrājata wa naẓara bil-minẓāri ilal-jabal
dialogue.en: The boy rode the bicycle and looked at the mountain through the binoculars.
dialogue.ur: Ladke ne cycle chalayi aur durbeen se pahad ki taraf dekha.

q.ur: «اسْمُ الآلَةِ» kis ka naam hota hai?

options: A tool used to do an action

q.en: Which tool does the farmer use to plough?
q.ur: Kisan zameen jotne ke liye kya istemal karta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ يَسْتَعْمِلُها الفَلّاحُ لِحَرْثِ الأَرْضِ؟

q.en: Which one is a pattern of «اسْمُ الآلَةِ»?
q.ur: Inmein se kaun sa ism-ul-aala ka wazan hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ هَذِهِ الأَوْزانِ وَزْنٌ مِنْ أَوْزانِ «اسْمِ الآلَةِ»؟

options_ar: أَداةٌ تُوضَعُ عَلى العَيْنَيْنِ لِتُحَسِّنَ الرُّؤْيَةَ

title.ar: القِراءَةُ المُوَسَّعَةُ: دُروسٌ مِنَ السُّنَّةِ الصَّحيحَةِ
title.en: Extended reading: Lessons from the authentic Sunnah
title.ur: Wasee qirat: Sahih sunnat se sabaq

intro.en: Long hadith texts from the Sunnah (narrated in Sahih Muslim and agreed upon): the man who hired workers, the three men of Bani Israel who were tested, and the boy and the king. Lessons: sincerity, being thankful and patience. The last slides are answers to the exercises.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein sunnat ki lambi ahadees hain (Sahih Muslim aur muttafaq alaih): mazdooron ko ujrat dene wala aadmi, Bani Israel ke teen aazmaye gaye aadmi, aur larka aur badshah. Sabaq: ikhlas, shukr aur sabr. Aakhri slides mashqon ke jawabat hain.
intro.ar: نُصوصٌ حَديثِيَّةٌ طَويلَةٌ مِنَ السُّنَّةِ الصَّحيحَةِ (في صَحيحِ مُسْلِمٍ وَمُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْها): الرَّجُلُ الَّذي اسْتَأْجَرَ عُمّالًا، وَالثَّلاثَةُ مِنْ بَني إِسْرائيلَ الَّذينَ ابْتُلوا، وَالغُلامُ وَالمَلِكُ. وَمِنْ دُروسِها الإِخْلاصُ وَالشُّكْرُ وَالصَّبْرُ. وَالشَّرائِحُ الأَخيرَةُ إِجاباتُ التَّمارينِ.

dialogue.ar: قالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: «وَقالَ الثّالِثُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اسْتَأْجَرْتُ أُجَراءَ فَأَعْطَيْتُهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ غَيْرَ رَجُلٍ واحِدٍ.»
dialogue.tr: qāla n-nabiyyu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: wa-qāla th-thālith: allāhumma innī ista'jartu ujarāʾa fa-aʿṭaytuhum ajrahum ghayra rajulin wāḥid
dialogue.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: The third said: O Allah, I hired workers and gave them their wages, except one man.
dialogue.ur: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: Teesre ne kaha: Aye Allah, maine mazdoor rakhe aur sabko unki ujrat de di, siwaye ek aadmi ke.

dialogue.ar: تَرَكَ الَّذي لَهُ وَذَهَبَ.
dialogue.tr: taraka lladhī lahu wa-dhahab
dialogue.en: He left what was his and went away.
dialogue.ur: Woh apna haq chhor kar chala gaya.

dialogue.ar: فَثَمَّرْتُ أَجْرَهُ حَتّى كَثُرَتْ مِنْهُ الأَمْوالُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-thammartu ajrahu ḥattā kathurat minhu l-amwāl
dialogue.en: I invested his wage until much wealth came from it.
dialogue.ur: Maine uski ujrat ko barhaya yahan tak ke bahut maal ho gaya.

dialogue.ar: فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: كُلُّ ما تَرى مِنْ أَجْرِكَ مِنَ الإِبِلِ وَالبَقَرِ وَالغَنَمِ وَالرَّقيقِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-qultu lahu: kullu mā tarā min ajrika mina l-ibili wal-baqari wal-ghanami war-raqīq
dialogue.en: I said to him: All you see is from your wage: camels, cows, sheep and slaves.
dialogue.ur: Maine usse kaha: Jo kuch tum dekhte ho woh tumhari ujrat hai: oont, gaayein, bakriyan aur ghulam.

dialogue.ar: فَأَخَذَهُ كُلَّهُ فَاسْتاقَهُ فَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً.
dialogue.tr: fa-akhadhahu kullahu fa-stāqahu fa-lam yatruk minhu shayʾā
dialogue.en: He took it all and drove it away, leaving nothing.
dialogue.ur: Usne sab kuch le liya aur hank kar le gaya, kuch na chhoda.

dialogue.ar: فَانْفَرَجَتِ الصَّخْرَةُ فَخَرَجوا يَمْشونَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-nfarajati ṣ-ṣakhratu fa-kharajū yamshūn
dialogue.en: The rock opened up and they went out walking.
dialogue.ur: Chattan khul gayi aur woh chalte hue bahar nikal aaye.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ ثَلاثَةً في بَني إِسْرائيلَ: أَبْرَصَ وَأَقْرَعَ وَأَعْمى.
dialogue.tr: inna thalāthatan fī banī isrāʾīl: abraṣa wa-aqraʿa wa-aʿmā
dialogue.en: There were three men among the Children of Israel: a leper, a bald man and a blind man.
dialogue.ur: Bani Israel mein teen aadmi the: ek korhi, ek ganja aur ek andha.

dialogue.ar: فَأَرادَ اللهُ أَنْ يَبْتَلِيَهُمْ فَبَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ مَلَكاً.
dialogue.tr: fa-arāda llāhu an yabtaliyahum fa-baʿatha ilayhim malakan
dialogue.en: Allah wanted to test them, so He sent an angel to them.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne unhein aazmana chaha to unki taraf ek farishta bheja.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ: أَمْسِكْ مالَكَ فَإِنَّما ابْتُلِيتُمْ فَقَدْ رَضِيَ عَنْكَ وَسَخِطَ عَلى صاحِبَيْكَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-qāla: amsik mālaka fa-innamā ubtulītum fa-qad raḍiya ʿanka wa-sakhiṭa ʿalā ṣāḥibayk
dialogue.en: He said: Keep your wealth, you were only tested; Allah is pleased with you and angry with your two companions.
dialogue.ur: Usne kaha: Apna maal rakho, tum sab aazmaye gaye the; Allah tum se razi hua aur tumhare dono saathiyon se naraz hua.

dialogue.ar: قيلَ لِلْغُلامِ: ارْجِعْ عَنْ دينِكَ.
dialogue.tr: qīla lil-ghulām: irjiʿ ʿan dīnik
dialogue.en: The boy was told: Go back from your religion.
dialogue.ur: Larke se kaha gaya: Apne deen se phir jao.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ قالَ: بِاسْمِ اللهِ رَبِّ الغُلامِ.
dialogue.tr: thumma qāla: bismi llāhi rabbi l-ghulām
dialogue.en: Then he said: In the name of Allah, the Lord of the boy.
dialogue.ur: Phir usne kaha: Is larke ke Rab Allah ke naam se.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ النّاسُ: آمَنّا بِرَبِّ الغُلامِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-qāla n-nās: āmannā bi-rabbi l-ghulām
dialogue.en: The people said: We believe in the Lord of the boy.
dialogue.ur: Logon ne kaha: Hum is larke ke Rab par eman laye.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ لَها الغُلامُ: يا أُمَّهْ اصْبِري فَإِنَّكِ عَلى الحَقِّ.
dialogue.tr: fa-qāla lahā l-ghulām: yā ummah iṣbirī fa-innaki ʿalā l-ḥaqq
dialogue.en: The boy said to her: O mother, be patient, for you are on the truth.
dialogue.ur: Larke ne us se kaha: Ammi, sabr karein, aap haq par hain.

q.en: Which three people were tested among the Children of Israel?
q.ur: Bani Israel mein kin teen logon ko aazmaya gaya?
q.ar: مَنِ الثَّلاثَةُ الَّذينَ ابْتُلوا مِنْ بَني إِسْرائيلَ؟

options: A leper, a bald man and a blind man
A king, a monk and a boy
A farmer, a cook and a judge

q.en: What did the boy say to the woman at the end of the text?
q.ur: Aakhir mein larke ne aurat se kya kaha?
q.ar: ماذا قالَ الغُلامُ لِلمَرْأَةِ في آخِرِ النَّصِّ؟

options: Be patient, you are on the truth

options_ar: ما يُعْطى مُقابِلَ العَمَلِ أَوِ الثَّوابُ

q.en: What happened after the man's prayer in the story of the workers?
q.ur: Mazdooron wali kahani mein dua ke baad kya hua?
q.ar: ماذا حَدَثَ بَعْدَ دُعاءِ الرَّجُلِ في القِصَّةِ؟

options: The rock opened and they walked out
